# Browser dependencies

- Jodit 4.18.3 (MIT): native visual HTML editor, loaded only when editing. License in JODIT-LICENSE.txt.
- DOMPurify 3.4.17 (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0): sanitizes editing/preview HTML. License in DOMPURIFY-LICENSE.txt.

No Firebase SDK, Decap CMS, GitHub login, OAuth client secret or database credential is shipped to browsers.
